reuse.why: Leaves the tree's single weekend definition (applyWeekendRule) and the rrule builder recurConfigToRSchedule (whose daily case could filter weekdays) untouched, and writes separate daily-skip logic in three callers.

duplication.why: The 'daily and skipWeekend means skip' test and weekend filtering are written separately in getNextDate, getUpcomingDates and schedule-template's movesWeekends.

placement.why: Part of the rule is in shared/schedules.ts getNextDate, but server/schedules/app.ts and budget/schedule-template.ts each decide it themselves rather than calling a shared definition.

scope.why: Edits are on-topic; the frequency is added to the RSchedule data blob to support the shared check.

maintainability.why: Three independent encodings with heuristics (take 7, count*4, `movesWeekends ? true : false`) will drift; getDatesInRange-style callers must remember the new special case.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getUpcomingDates (server/schedules/app.ts) and createScheduleList (schedule-template.ts) decide daily weekend skipping themselves instead of via applyWeekendRule or recurConfigToRSchedule

disguised_duplication.where: The daily-skip condition appears as `frequency === 'daily'` in getNextDate, `skipsWeekends` in getUpcomingDates and the negated `movesWeekends` in schedule-template, each with its own weekend filtering.

one_place.where: Daily-skip rule split across getNextDate (shared/schedules.ts), getUpcomingDates (server/schedules/app.ts) and createScheduleList (server/budget/schedule-template.ts); applyWeekendRule, documented as the single definition, is unchanged.
